title: Echo Canvas Lab
summary: A local spatial-audio workbench with deterministic geometry, doorway routing, and revision-safe WebAudio controls.
evidence: Original code inspired by Kevin Yang; geometry and audio lifecycle checks.

decisions: Make acoustic-path approximations visible and testable.
